_meta.purpose: Real, citable literature grounding for the genetic direction-of-effect calls in concordance_snapshot.json / the per-gene dossiers. Replaces bare 'literature_expectation' assertions with PMIDs + DOIs. Open Targets remained rate-limited; these citations are the interim evidence base.
_meta.attribution_note: According to PubMed. DOIs are the canonical links for each reference below.

references.title: Early-onset autoimmunity associated with SOCS1 haploinsufficiency.
references.claim: Heterozygous germline LOSS-OF-FUNCTION SOCS1 mutations cause dominantly inherited early-onset autoimmunity (increased STAT activation). => LoF raises autoimmune risk (risk_lof); confirms SOCS1 is a human immune brake.

references.title: Haploinsufficiency in PTPN2 leads to early-onset systemic autoimmunity from Evans syndrome to lupus.
references.claim: Groups SOCS1 with PTPN2 as monogenic autoimmune diseases from LoF of negative regulators of cytokine signaling (supporting SOCS1 risk_lof).

references.title: Variants within the immunoregulatory CBLB gene are associated with multiple sclerosis.
references.claim: GWAS: CBLB variant rs9657904 associated with MS, overall P=1.6e-10, OR=1.40 (GENOME-WIDE SIGNIFICANT). CBLB is a negative regulator; Cblb-null mice are EAE-prone => risk_lof.

references.title: Regulation of peripheral T cell tolerance by the E3 ubiquitin ligase Cbl-b.
references.claim: Cbl-b loss renders animals susceptible to antigen-triggered autoimmunity ('key autoimmunity gene') and Cbl-b-deficient mice reject tumors => risk_lof + IO rationale.

references.title: SNPs at the TNFAIP3/A20 locus and susceptibility/resistance to inflammatory and autoimmune diseases.
references.claim: GWAS SNPs that DECREASE A20 expression / NF-kB-inhibitory function associate with SLE and other autoimmune/inflammatory disease => risk_lof. Also notes A20-KO mouse lethality/multi-organ failure (supports tumor-suppressor/safety flag).

references.title: UBASH3A Mediates Risk for Type 1 Diabetes Through Inhibition of T-Cell Receptor-Induced NF-kB Signaling.
references.claim: T1D RISK alleles (rs11203203, rs80054410) INCREASE UBASH3A expression in human CD4 T cells, suppressing NF-kB/IL-2. => higher UBASH3A drives risk, so LOSS is protective (protective_lof). Direct support for the sole concordant hero call.

references.title: T Cell Receptor Genotype and Ubash3a Determine Susceptibility to Rat Autoimmune Diabetes.
references.claim: In vivo rat model: UBASH3A provides downstream immunoregulation modulating T1D susceptibility (consistent with UBASH3A as a TCR brake).

references.title: RASA2 ablation in T cells boosts antigen sensitivity and long-term function.
references.claim: RASA2 identified via genome-wide CRISPR-KO screens as a signalling checkpoint; ablation enhances CAR-T cytolysis, persistence, anti-tumor efficacy. Strong FUNCTIONAL/novelty support; NO directional human-genetics => concordance direction = none.

CD5.note: No genome-wide-significant directional human-genetics citation retrieved this pass; kept out of the directional funnel. Tractability/clinical evidence is in CD5.json (ChEMBL immunotoxins + 15 active CD5 CAR-T/CAR-NK trials).

TCEB2.note: Direction = none (housekeeping/likely pan-essential complex subunit). No directional immune-genetics citation applicable.

ARID1A.note: Direction = none for immune set-point. ARID1A genetics is somatic tumor-suppressor / developmental (Coffin-Siris), not immune GWAS.

references.title: Genome-wide CRISPR Screens in Primary Human T Cells Reveal Key Regulators of Immune Function.
references.claim: Primary-dataset lineage (SLICE). Genome-wide LoF screens found genes that NEGATIVELY tune proliferation after stimulation; targeted ablation enhanced cancer-cell killing. Basis for the pre-registered expected KO hit list.
